name: Faithful Channel
body:
Your devotion grants you some more clerical abilities.

Prerequisite(s): Ability to cast 2nd-level divine spells, Cha 13, must have a familiar.

Benefit: You gain the channel energy class feature, as a legendary cleric. This functions like the cleric’s channel energy ability, except that your effective cleric level is equal to your divine spellcasting class level –4.
